note: which cohort_calibrated checks this cohort has derived or adopted, and on what evidence. the contract holds the default value; this file holds the warrant. a cohort with no such file inherits nothing - every cohort_calibrated check escalates.

status_values.adopted: taken as given for this cohort, with the basis stated
status_values.escalate: recorded but not accepted - the check escalates as if absent

spatial_autocorrelation.provenance: notebooks/exploration/eda_biological_signal.ipynb - one subarray, CN1/C1, 1,075 tissue-selected spots, k=6, 999 permutations. 5 of the top 5 markers cleared 0.3.
spatial_autocorrelation.flagged_at_source: eda_biological_signal.ipynb cell 22 states in writing that this is CN1/C1 only and that the median across all subarrays is needed for the registered report. the caveat was written down and then lost between the notebook and the gate.

cohort_recomputation.result: 2 of the top 5 markers above 0.3 - COL1A1 0.532, ERBB2 0.363; CD79A 0.284, CD37 0.173, CD3D 0.165 fall below
cohort_recomputation.reading: CN1/C1 sits above the cohort median on 9 of 10 genes, with the largest gaps on immune markers. structure is present in stroma and tumour architecture; the immune markers collapse, which is coherent for a cohort containing immune-cold cases.
cohort_recomputation.not_acted_on: recorded, not adjudicated. the verdict on this cohort is unchanged pending a human decision on the criterion itself, which has no external basis to fall back to.

spatial_autocorrelation.does_not_invalidate: the molecular encoder routing had independent support under encoder_validation.novae (spatial rho, effective rank, z-score tests). the recomputation invalidates one justification, not the routing.

positive_markers.provenance: notebooks/exploration/eda_biological_signal.ipynb - panel declared in project.json for this tissue and disease context; detection reported as percent of units with non-zero expression.
positive_markers.scope: n=1 of 281 samples - cell 13 loads count_files[0] and cell 16 reuses the same frame, so every reported percentage is CN1/C1
positive_markers.caveat: CN1/C1 is now known to sit above the cohort median on immune markers, so the immune and proliferation percentages carry the same optimistic bias the Moran's I did. the panel itself is corroborated independently by the clinical table.

negative_markers.provenance: same notebook and same single subarray as positive_markers. the controls are negative because of this cohort's disease context, and the clinical table corroborates that independently of the expression data.
negative_markers.caveat: percent-expressing is computed on log-normalised, per-gene batch-corrected values. if the correction shifts structural zeros off zero, the quantity being reported is not a detection rate. detection rates require raw integer counts.

batch_structure.provenance: notebooks/exploration/eda_data_inventory.ipynb - pseudobulk per sample, PCA, silhouette by plate, lane and subtype across the cohort.
batch_structure.observed: every silhouette negative (technical -0.054 to -0.081, biological -0.053 to -0.143), so the absolute floor is not load-bearing here - the comparative half decides it.
